against: KB capability_claims from Sheet Collection.Roles (data layer)
claim: The typal role tags the KB carries are incomplete. 'Changeling' tags 12 of the 18 owned cards with the Changeling keyword (it misses Barkform Harvester, Changeling Wayfinder, Crib Swap, Firdoch Core, Graveshifter and Realmwalker). 'Choose a creature type' tags 5 cards; at least 15 owned cards say 'choose a creature type' or 'chosen type' (it misses Gathering Stone, Distant Melody, Kindred Judgment, Secluded Courtyard, Unclaimed Territory, Haunting Voyage and others). No contract records a chosen-type predicate in its query_index, though DIO 4.1 names creature type and chosen type as qualifier axes. disposition: Proposed for the next KB release: derive Changeling from the keyword field, and add a typal capability (chosen type, shares a creature type, grants every type) to the grammar layer and contracts as a query_index qualifier. Then mtgtools typal reads it and drops the lexical lookup.

claim: mtgtools typal reads KB rules text for phrases ('choose a creature type', 'every creature type', the type's name). A downstream tool that reads card text risks the F-P01 pattern. Counter-reading: P-01 allows a declared reading that is not used as truth. Every lexical hit carries basis 'lexical:...' and support lexical_match (grade exploratory), the verb never decides whether a payoff applies, and tag_gaps reports where the KB is missing the fact. If the concern is right, the lookup becomes a second semantic authority once agents start to trust its buckets.

claim: The contracts do not record counter type or polarity. 78 current contracts have '-1/-1' in their exact text, and none carries it in query_index, so no tool can tell a +1/+1 engine (TMNT) from a -1/-1 engine (Blight Curse); CR 704.5q makes them cancel. Two related misreadings surfaced in the same test: Evolution Sage's proliferate has feeds [] (proliferate puts counters, but only of kinds already present), and Lasting Tarfire records counter.put as a feed when 'if you put a counter on a creature this turn' is its condition, not its output.
evidence: Zach's blind ChatGPT decommission test (Auntie Ool into TMNT), 2026-10-31; sqlite: current_contracts query_index for Evolution Sage, Lasting Tarfire; count of '-1/-1' in exact_text
disposition: Proposed for the next KB release: a counter_kind qualifier (plus_one, minus_one, named, any) on counter.put producers and listeners, proliferate as counter.put restricted to present kinds, and intervening-if conditions kept out of feeds. mtgtools release flags -1/-1 cards by text until then.

against: kb/contracts.py drafting from Sheet Mechanics Operations (P-02)
claim: C-015 narrowed: counter identity is lost between layers, not absent from the project. The DIO says a counter's sign must not be assumed (v3.1.1 state table, the polarity rule, persist's -1/-1 counter as a state gate). The grammar layer records counter_kind on 758 abilities (nest on Twitching Doll, -1/-1 on Contagion Clasp and Persist). The KB contracts are drafted from the Sheet's Mechanics Operations, where kind 'counters' maps to a bare counter.put (kb/contracts.py), so the kind is dropped and generic wording ('a counter', 'each counter', 'with counters') is not marked as 'any'. This is an F-P02 failure: a rules-relevant distinction does not survive Oracle -> contract. The grammar layer has its own defects here: Puca's Covenant's 'a counter on it' parses as counter_kind 'of', and proliferate compiles to no counter operation. Player counters (poison, energy, experience) need the counter's holder as well as its kind.
evidence: grammar_layer.sqlite ability_contract (758 with counter_kind); KB current_contracts for Twitching Doll, Contagion Clasp, Puca's Covenant, Evolution Sage; kb/contracts.py line 36
disposition: Proposed fix in a KB release: carry counter_kind (a named kind or 'any') and holder (permanent or player) on every counter.put/remove/move producer, listener, amplifier and state predicate, filled from the grammar layer. Compile proliferate as counter.put restricted to kinds already present. Matching: named against named must be equal; an 'any' listener accepts every kind; a named listener against an 'any' producer is 'possible'. Record SBA annihilation of +1/+1 against -1/-1 (CR 704.5q) as a counter.remove of both kinds.

claim: Counter identity now has two readers of the same Oracle text: the grammar layer's counter_kind (758 abilities) and kb/counters.py (705 contracts, 632 cards). The KB build does not consume the grammar DB, and the grammar parse has known counter errors (Puca's Covenant's kind read as 'of'; proliferate compiles to no counter operation), so this release reads counters in kb/ rather than wait. If both keep growing they will disagree, and a downstream layer will be deriving what the grammar layer is meant to own.
evidence: kb/counters.py; grammar_layer.sqlite ability_contract.counter_kind; RELEASE_NOTES_v0.2.1-r20261031.md; codex_++/intents/2026-10-31__kb.counters.intent.md
